messages:
sam_peopleops: Quick thread 30 hiring update that needs comp-committee sign-off + payroll timing. Candidate Daniel R. (SWE-3) accepted contingent on base $230k + $12k sign-on. Current SWE-3 top is $215k, so this needs an exception. Also candidate can move start earlier to 2026-06-08 if we can expedite paperwork.

kai_recruiter: Candidate gave verbal accept last night. Wants start 06/08 due to giving 2 weeks notice early. Asking for base $230k 22market-adjust22 and $12k sign-on. No relocation.

lena_manager: Team strongly wants Dan onboard ASAP. We have active project ramp the week of 06/15; starting 06/08 would let us onboard before sprint. Approve the comp request from a team perspective.

ethan_comp: tagging comp-committee for review. Please note candidate is SWE-3 but has differentiated backend infra experience. Recommend we consider a one-time uplift.

comp-committee: Reviewed quickly. We can approve an exception to increase base to $228k (one-time band uplift) OR approve $230k if hiring manager moves one level sign-off escalation to Director. Because urgency is high, committee votes: APPROVE $228k base + $12k sign-on. Condition: Offer must be sent by 2026-05-27 and compensation approval email archived.

kai_recruiter: Understood. Two operational Qs: 1) benefits effective if start 06/08? 2) payroll cutoff for new hires to be paid first payroll on 06/15?

zoe_payroll: Payroll runs: cutoff for 06/08 start to be active for 06/15 pay is 06/01. Benefits enrollment effective date can be 06/08 if HR paperwork enters system before 06/01. If we miss cutoff, benefits will start 07/01.

sam_peopleops: HR-bot reminder: submit Offer Approval form and attach manager approval screenshot + comp-committee email. Link: https://ok.redwood/offers/form. I'll prep an exception record in our log (OA-2026-700).

hr-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Offer Approval form not yet received for thread 1899991234. Please submit before 2026-05-27 to match comp-committee condition.

kai_recruiter: Pasting offer summary to confirm before sending:

``` 
Offer Summary - Daniel R.
Role: SWE-3
Approved Base: $228,000 (comp-committee exception)
Sign-on: $12,000
Start: 2026-06-08 (early start requested)
Benefits effective: 2026-06-08 (pending payroll cutoff 06/01)
Conditions: Offer sent by 2026-05-27; attach comp-committee email; cap documented
```

lena_manager: I'll approve the final offer doc. Please cc me and People Ops when sent so we can schedule onboarding.

zoe_payroll: Finance/payroll ok with sign-on charge. Please include cost center ENG-INFRA-26 in the offer approval form.

sam_peopleops: Great 30 next steps: 1) Kai send formal offer with comp note by 05/27. 2) Kai attach signed manager approval + comp-committee email to Offer Approval form. 3) Payroll & benefits will confirm once paperwork lands pre-06/01.

kai_recruiter: Will send today and update thread when accepted. Thanks all. :rocket:
